lessonTitle: 27. The inverse function and its graph
lessonTitleEnglish: The inverse function and its graph
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: If f is monotonic, each value y comes from one x; that correspondence is the inverse function: y = 2x + 1 gives x = (y − 1)/2, so the inverse is y = (x − 1)/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: If f is monotonic, each value y comes from one x; that correspondence is the inverse function: y = 2x + 1 gives x = (y − 1)/2, so the inverse is y = (x − 1)/2.

stages.headline: The graphs of a function and its inverse are symmetric about the line y = x.
stages.headlineEnglish: The graphs of a function and its inverse are symmetric about the line y = x.

stages.headline: The inverse of y = x² (x ≥ 0) is y = √x; on all of ℝ, y = x² has no inverse because it is not monotonic.
stages.headlineEnglish: The inverse of y = x² (x ≥ 0) is y = √x; on all of ℝ, y = x² has no inverse because it is not monotonic.
